recognize_zh: H&E 400 倍下，淋巴結大片被泡沫狀、淡粉紅色的組織球取代，組織球內可見許多小而圓、帶透明暈的空泡狀菌體；中下方殘留一片小淋巴球。整片「泡泡狀」組織球加上幾乎沒有肉芽腫反應，應想到 HIV 病人的 Cryptococcus 感染。
features: Sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale, bubbly cytoplasm replacing lymph node architecture
Numerous small round intracytoplasmic yeasts with clear halos, giving a soap-bubble pattern
Scattered residual small lymphocytes forming a central band
Absence of well-formed granulomas or necrosis in this field
Bland spindle to oval histiocyte and endothelial nuclei
describe_en: Lymph node biopsy, H&E, shows effacement by sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm. At higher magnification the vacuoles contain numerous round yeast forms of variable size surrounded by clear capsular halos, producing a soap-bubble pattern; residual small lymphocytes are present centrally and well-formed granulomas are absent. Findings are suggestive of cryptococcal lymphadenitis in an immunocompromised host; special stains (mucicarmine, GMS) are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: MAC produces sheets of foamy or striated histiocytes without discrete round yeasts, and the organisms are acid-fast bacilli.
Histoplasma yeasts are tiny (2–4 µm) and uniform within histiocytes, lacking variably sized yeasts with wide clear capsules.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100-positive, show emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes and plasma cells, and contain no organisms.
Carcinoma shows cohesive atypical epithelial cells with keratin positivity rather than bland histiocytes packed with capsule-bearing yeasts.
